parents.course: Latin American Diaspora through Film: Beyond Braceros, Narcos, and Latin Lovers

ns2:section.sectionText: This is an asynchronous online lecture. Work for this component of the course will consist of video lectures and assignments available through the course Moodle site. Students must also register for one of the discussion sections (either AD1, AD2, AD3, AD4, AD5, AD6, AD7).If the course is full, students can add their names to the waitlist at go.illinois.edu/SPAN_waitlist
